subject: Post-call: FinCo security QA & SIG initiation — scope, API/dataflow, and next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finco.com>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@finco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: FinCo security QA & SIG initiation — scope, API/dataflow, and next steps

Hi Marta / Amit —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the security side while your procurement team loops in legal. Action items below and a couple of clarifying questions where your input will help us size the work and pick the right questionnaire path (SIG vs CAIQ vs lightweight custom):

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- FinCo expects SOC 2 Type II within the next 6 months and needs evidence of controls for production systems.
- Primary concerns: data residency (US only for initial scope), handling of PHI (you said limited to pseudonymized records today, may expand), and encryption key ownership.
- You want an initial vendor questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ) + an architecture/dataflow diagram showing API paths and where PII/PHI is persisted.

Requests from our side (what we'll deliver and what we need from you):
1) We will attach a short SOC 2 summary and our subprocessors list for your review (attached). Please confirm whether your procurement needs the full SOC report or a SOC 2 summary first.
2) Please confirm the FinCo data residency requirement for backups and audit logs (US-only or also EU?).
3) Confirm whether any of the FinCo test environments you plan to use will send PHI to Redwood during evaluation — that changes the evidence set.
4) For KMS: do you require customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) for production, or is provider-managed keys acceptable for the initial integration?

Plan / timeline proposal:
- Today: share SOC2 summary, subprocessor list, and a dataflow sketch (attached).
- Next 48–72 hours: Ben will open a SIG portal entry and prefill CAIQ sections we can answer.
- Week of Nov 30: technical deep-dive with our infra engineer (to walk API flows and storage behavior).

Attachments (sent): redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf, redwood-dataflow-api-diagram.vsdx, redwood-subprocessors-2026.csv

Please reply with answers to items 2–4 above and let us know if you prefer SIG (broad/comprehensive) or a shorter CAIQ-style prefill to start. If you want, we can also do a short joint call next week to walk through the diagram.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

— Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.example.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Amit Patel <amit.patel@finco.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinCo security QA & SIG initiation — scope, API/dataflow, and next steps

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifying questions before we decide SIG vs CAIQ. Answers inline.

2) Data residency for backups/audit logs: US-only for production is required at contract signing. We may require EU later but not for this initial purchase.

3) PHI in test environments: for evaluation we will *not* send PHI to Redwood. Production may include PHI; that will be called out in the contract and determines if HIPAA evidence is required.

4) KMS: our security policy prefers customer-managed keys (BYOK) for production, but we can accept provider-managed for a short pilot. If you support HSM-backed BYOK, please note that in your response.

Additional questions (to help us prefill):
- Does Redwood persist full request payloads by default, or is a streaming-only mode available where you do not store request content?
- What is your default retention period for logs and for generated content? Can retention be set per-customer?
- Who are your subprocessors for telemetry/monitoring (we saw a list but would like the primary contacts for support if we need to escalate)?

We're leaning toward starting with a targeted CAIQ prefill + architecture diagram review, and then moving to a SIG if controls detail is required for HIPAA.

Thanks — I can share a short questionnaire template if helpful.

— Marta
Head of Security Operations | FinCo
Marta.Ruiz@finco.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@finco.com>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@finco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinCo security QA & SIG initiation — scope, API/dataflow, and next steps

Marta — thanks for the quick follow-up and great questions. Answers below (inline) and next steps.

> Does Redwood persist full request payloads by default, or is a streaming-only mode available where you do not store request content?
We persist request/response payloads by default for a configurable retention window (used for debugging, evals, and safety monitoring). We do offer a streaming-only integration for customers who do not want persistence during evaluation — that can be enabled via the API flag and is commonly used for proofs-of-concept.

> What is your default retention period for logs and for generated content? Can retention be set per-customer?
Default retention: logs 90 days, generated content 30 days. Yes — retention windows can be adjusted per-customer on our Dedicated/Private tiers and via support request for Hosted with the right contract addendum.

> Who are your subprocessors for telemetry/monitoring?
Primary subprocessors: Datadog (monitoring/alerts), S3-compatible object storage partners (backups), and a managed KMS provider (we support both provider-managed and BYOK via HSM integrations). I'll attach an updated subprocessors CSV with primary contacts.

Additional clarifications based on your preferences:
- We support BYOK/HSM for production. Ben will share HSM integration doc and typical onboarding steps.
- For the pilot we can enable provider-managed keys and streaming-only ingest so no persisted PHI exists during evaluation.

Planned next steps (we'll take these actions):
- Today: Ben will open a CAIQ prefill in the SIG portal and mark the initial classification as 'pilot / no PHI persisted'.
- Monday: Share CAIQ prefill and SOC2 summary link; Ben to attach HSM/BYOK onboarding doc.
- Week of Nov 30: schedule technical dataflow walkthrough with infra and security (I'll include Amit).

If this sounds good I'll proceed to open the portal entry and prefill.

— Jordan
